Title: Delegate administration of applications in Azure Active Directory

Body.Content:
Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) now offers three administrator roles for application management. These dedicated roles can help your company set the appropriate access controls to the directory for application development, configuration, management and delegation, and reduce the dependency on the Global Admin role. For more in-depth access control and monitoring capabilities, these roles can be managed with Azure AD Privileged Identity Management. 

Learn more.
